## Context / Problem
ADR 0086's cross-ticket overlap detector ships as a write-path enrichment queue: `src/rebar/_store/event_append.py:385-387` and `src/rebar/_store/push.py:590-596` call `rebar.llm.enrich_drain.maybe_drain` after every write, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py:216-233` enqueues `ENQUEUE_ENRICH` at certification, and `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:600-612` runs BM25F retrieval plus an LLM judge inside `review-plan`. Each drained ticket pushed about 4 commits on the shared `tickets` branch (`rebar.toml:205-211`), starving other writers; the feature is off here (`rebar.toml:42,216`) and upstream, so 2,280 LOC plus 13 config keys, 13 env vars, a CLI verb, two prompts, two schemas and a doctor lock leg are dead surface. `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets` also gates the cheap create-time journal (`_commands/recent_creates.py:148`), so disabling the detector disabled the journal. Operator decisions (2026-09-06): remove the implementation; keep the four event-type names so ~105k historical events parse; re-enable the journal; no tombstones (ADR 0116 `:65-68`). Cites: origin/main 2e81cb9767c1.

## Approach
Delete the modules and their CLI, prompt, schema, and contract registrations; cut each hook from the kept files; keep `TICKET_DIGEST`, `ENQUEUE_ENRICH`, `CLAIM_ENRICH`, `DONE_ENRICH` in `src/rebar/reducer/_version.py:53-56` (`_NON_REPLAY_KNOWN_TYPES`, sole external reader `_engine_support/bridge_fsck.py:115`) and `src/rebar/_store/event_prepare.py:73-80` (`EVENT_TYPES` write allowlist: `tests/unit/test_store.py:80-86`'s drift guard holds and the regression test appends the four types normally) with a "retired producer" comment; narrow `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets` to the journal and flip it to `true` in `rebar.toml` in the SAME commit as the code removal (else `true` re-arms the billable overlap step at `plan_review/__init__.py:607-612`); regenerate every CI-gated artifact; add one regression test proving the four retired types still reduce, survive compaction, and fsck clean. `[llm]` is reserved (`_config_sections.py:187,201`), so a leftover `[llm] overlap_*` key is silently ignored even under `REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error`; the release note says so; warning on `[llm]` keys belongs to the config epic (`_config_sections.py:180-183` must not import `rebar.llm`). `reviewers/index.json` has no digest/judge entry today. `gen_cli_help.py` `_write()` unlinks strays (`:195,229`): regen removes `help/enrich.txt`, re-renders `overview.txt:53`. `plan_review_verdict.schema.json` never declares `overlap` (`:7`, `additionalProperties: true`): no schema or `types.py` edit.

## Scope
Delete: `src/rebar/llm/overlap/` (7 modules, 1,439 LOC), `src/rebar/llm/enrich.py` (206), `src/rebar/llm/enrich_drain.py` (635), `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/enrich.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/help/enrich.txt` (via regen), `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/ticket_digest.md`, `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/overlap_judge.md`, `src/rebar/schemas/ticket_digest.schema.json`, `src/rebar/schemas/overlap_verdict.schema.json`, `scripts/overlap_judge_calibrate.py`, `docs/calibration/overlap_batch_confidence.md` and `.output.txt` plus the `docs/README.md:142` link to the former (keeps `check_docs_index.py --check` at 0); tests `tests/unit/test_{enrich,enrich_drain,enrich_queue,overlap_judge,overlap_retrieve,plan_review_overlap,ticket_digest_store}.py`, `tests/fixtures/enrich_quality/*.json` (6), `tests/fixtures/overlap_pairs/*.json` (13).

Edit (kept src and tests): the exact line-level list is in this ticket's first comment; the kept files are `_store/event_append.py`, `_store/push.py`, `llm/plan_review/attest.py`, `llm/plan_review/__init__.py`, `_engine_support/reads_cli.py`, `_cli/_llm_commands.py`, `_cli/_registry.py`, `_cli/__init__.py`, `llm/__init__.py`, `llm/config.py`, `llm/config_readers.py`, `llm/config_binding.py`, `llm/contracts.py`, `schemas/__init__.py`, `schemas/doctor.schema.json`, `_commands/doctor_locks.py`, `_config_schema.py`, `reducer/_version.py`, `_store/event_prepare.py`, `rebar.toml`, `scripts/probe_rebar.py`, `docs/exit-codes.md` (drop the `enrich` row `:178`, else `test_exit_codes.py:304` fails on an orphan), plus 26 test files; also the prose-only sites AC2 would hit: `_proc.py:17` and `_commands/compact_trigger.py:25` docstrings, the `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` `enrich_drain*` glob row, the `_llm_drain_mode` control in `tests/unit/test_env_registry_helper_coverage.py`, and three test docstrings naming `test_enrich_drain.py` (exact lines in the 2026-10-18 comment).

Add `test_retired_overlap_event_types_still_parse` to `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_event_schema_forward_compat.py` (assertions in the first comment); regenerate the seven CI-gated artifacts per that comment; never hand-edit `.github/*-baseline.json`.

## Testing
The ACs below are the test plan. Edge: `REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error rebar list` with `[llm] overlap_k = 20` exits 0 (silent-ignore, `_config_sections.py:201`); a leftover `.rebar/enrich-drain.lock` gets no doctor finding.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `git ls-files src/rebar/llm/overlap src/rebar/llm/enrich.py src/rebar/llm/enrich_drain.py src/rebar/_cli/help/enrich.txt src/rebar/schemas/ticket_digest.schema.json src/rebar/schemas/overlap_verdict.schema.json scripts/overlap_judge_calibrate.py` prints nothing.
- [x] `git grep -nE 'llm\.overlap|enrich_drain|_read_llm_overlap_settings|_llm_drain_mode|DEFAULT_OVERLAP_|overlap_drain|digest_freshness|REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP' -- src scripts tests rebar.toml .rebar ':!tests/fixtures/cloud_adf_corpus' ':!tests/fixtures/dc_wiki_corpus'` prints nothing; its pre-edit run (must list only deleted files plus the sites above) and post-edit run are pasted into a comment. (the two corpora are hash-pinned historical bodies).
- [x] `python -c "from rebar.reducer._version import _NON_REPLAY_KNOWN_TYPES as N; from rebar._store.event_prepare import EVENT_TYPES as E; assert {'TICKET_DIGEST','ENQUEUE_ENRICH','CLAIM_ENRICH','DONE_ENRICH'} <= N & E"` exits 0.
- [x] `pytest tests/interfaces/contracts/test_event_schema_forward_compat.py -k retired_overlap -q` prints `1 passed`.
- [x] `rebar review-plan <ticket> --output json | python -c "import json,sys; assert 'overlap' not in json.load(sys.stdin)"` exits 0 on one real ticket.
- [x] `rebar doctor --output json | python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert [l['name'] for l in d['locks']]==['tickets-write-fcntl','tickets-write-mkdir','hlc','compact-worker','snapshot-gc-worker']"` exits 0.
- [x] `rebar enrich status` exits 1 with `Error: unknown subcommand 'enrich'` on stderr; `rebar help` output has no `enrich` line.
- [x] `python -c "import tomllib;c=tomllib.load(open('rebar.toml','rb'));assert c['verify']['suggest_duplicate_tickets'] is True and 'overlap_drain' not in c['llm']"` exits 0, and two `rebar create task "same title"` within 600 s print a `possible duplicate` warning on stderr for the second (exit 0).
- [x] Each of `scripts/gen_{cli_help,cli_reference,env_registry,config_reference,api_surface}.py --check`, `python -m rebar.llm.prompting.prompts regenerate-index --check`, `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` (reports `new=0 increased=0` and one more `stale` than origin/main), `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` (`increased=0`, no unadmitted mechanism; `--update-stale` drained >=14 rows) exits 0 with no hand edit to either `.github/*-baseline.json`.
- [x] `git grep -nE 'overlap_batch_confidence|^\| `enrich`' -- docs` prints nothing, `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` exits 0, and `pytest tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_exit_codes.py -q` passes.
- [x] Local `make verify` fails only on the 17 pandoc host-defect tests (frenzied-snively-llama); the change reaches `Verified +1`.
